morphology.compounding_rule: Hellenic [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word with linking -o- (Megos-oros, the great mountain) layered over Maya [quality|color] + feature prefixes (Chak-witz, red-pyramid; Noh-kah, great-town): the capital Oracmaya (the oracle of the maya), Mantekuh-Witz (the oracle-temple pyramid).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Hellenic oracle-aristocracy keep a patronymic -ides/-ades (son of) plus the polis demonym; the Maya populace keep the ch'ib'al (lineage) name with the aj- (he of) / ix- (she of) prefix and calendar-day birth-names; the throne fuses both - an archon who carries an -ides line and a witz-seat dynasty.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: vine-choked pyramids and fallen porticoes: 'the lost Witz of [name]', 'the Sunken Manteion', 'the Stela-court of [ajaw]'
patterns.military_units: the [Adjective] Phalanx and the Maya Holkan: 'the Bronze Phalanx', 'the Jaguar Holkan', 'the Feather-helms'
patterns.ships: coastal galleys and the great seagoing trade-canoes: 'Pride of Oracmaya', 'the Jade Galley', 'the Quetzal of the Haos'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]' and the balche'-house: 'The Jade Kylix', 'The Cacao Court'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Hellenic reflexes PRIMARY (family_classical / achillean: Tulrios/Orlandros/Numenos, the -os/-on/-es Hellenic column), Mayan morphs SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican theonym_sets.mayan: Tulax/Orlanab/Numench), never real Greek/Maya gods (no Apollo, no Kukulkan). Shared pantheon; the oracle speaks in Hellenic names, the day-keeper in Maya names. Oracmaya allows Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The Delphic oracle-rite and the Maya bloodletting-and-day-count both bind the basileus to the powers; the manteion-portico and the witz-pyramid are twin altars.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as daimones (Hellenic demons) or k'ak'as (Maya evil), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame (Maya Marakab the War-Fire); Vacidus -> Wakix the Devourer (Hellenic Wakidaimon the Void); Lusanto -> Lusankaan the Hoard-Serpent.

holy_symbol_motifs.Orlandros: an iron spear crossed with the oath-ring and the war-standard
holy_symbol_motifs.Rialta: the moon-rabbit cradling maize above the olive-branch
holy_symbol_motifs.Tulrios: a radiate sun-disc above the oracle-tripod and the bloodletting-stela

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Manteion (Hellenic oracle-temple) or K'uh-nah (Maya god-house) atop the witz (pyramid) of [power]: 'the Manteion of Tulrios', 'the K'uh-nah of Tulax'.
religion.saints_pattern: the Heroes (deified founder-heroes, venerated at a heroon) and the deified k'uhul ajaw ancestors (the uchben), honored at the heroon-tomb, the carved stela, and the pyramid-acropolis.

Tulrius.gloss: the sun, the oracle, and right-order; Lawful power

religion.the_one: Aiternos (Hellenic; Maya Aj Ternaj) - the distant One, the unknowable source, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Aiternos - as the tyrant-gods to be defied; the bloodletting-rite turned to dread ends.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aiternos, Tulrios the just oracle, Orlandros of the sworn war, Rialta the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers as daimones (Hellenic) / k'ak'as (Maya evil), warded; the oracle-rite and the day-count bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - honored and feared by turns; foregrounds the deified founder-heroes (the Heroes) and the uchben (Maya ancestral dead), the day-lords and the local k'uh (spirits) invoked at the manteion-grove and the witz situationally

titles._tiers_note: Hellenic ladder, ascending, with the Maya substrate co-titles fused beneath. Toparch (district-lord) barony; Nakomarch (the Maya nakom war-captain fused to the Hellenic march) march; Eparch-Sajal (the provincial eparch over the Maya sajal governor) county - shown in DISPLAY as the approved foreign term 'Archon'; Strategos (general) duchy; Dynastes (prince-ruler) principality; Basileus (king) kingdom over a Basileia; Autokrator-Kalomte (the Hellenic autocrat fused to the Maya kalomte' high-king) empire over the Autokratoria. The conquered cities keep their Maya batab' (local chief) and ah-k'in (day-priest) beneath the Hellenic crown. Rank titles fuse the real Hellenic and Maya registers (allowed).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - here 'Archon' for the county). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Hellenic oracle-aristocracy over the Maya jungle-cities: the basileus and his dynastes-kin at the crown, the archon-governors over the poliskah-cities, the toparch-holders of the lesser seats; the ah-k'in day-keepers and the k'uh-nah priesthood serve beneath)
titles.heir: Diadochos (the successor-designate; the Maya call him the Baah-ch'ok, head-youth)
